A completed and signed application form (available on the City's website forms page).

Proof of your business name registration from the Florida Division of Corporations (Sunbiz).

Your 17-digit Parcel Control Number (PCN) for your business location, which can be found on the Palm Beach County Property Appraiser (PAPA) website.

In-Person: Bring your completed application to the Development Services lobby on the 1st Floor of City Hall at 401 Clematis Street, West Palm Beach, FL 33401.
